P3_0_interpretation.criteria: unchanged across both runs: >=19/20 valid, <=1 indeterminate, 0 false definitive; keyless, matching the production runtime contract
P3_0_interpretation.qualification: succeeded comfortably in both runs (90 and 91 qualified of 120 probed), so the failure is not a shortage of known-valid controls
P3_0_interpretation.false_definitive_zero: In both runs pokemontcg.io never misidentified a known-good card. It failed to answer, rather than answering wrongly.
P3_0_interpretation.meaning: This is a failure of the keyless fallback source to meet the audit's reliability threshold. It is NOT evidence about F or O coverage, and MUST NOT be read as one.
P3_0_interpretation.gate_integrity: The gate was not relaxed, modified or retried opportunistically. No third run was performed.

post_cat3a_roadmap_recommendation.policy_accepted: A retained provider-history image may be an admissible source for its canonical survivor ONLY where CAT-2D.2 has already independently established that the pair represents the same physical printing. Scoped to those 192 pairs and nothing else.

Direct writes to cards.image_url remain blocked because durability and provenance under future sync are unresolved: mapCardToRow performs a full-row upsert that rewrites image_url from upstream (sync-cards.mjs:332), there is no image provenance column (CAT-0 F-9), and card_extras overrides illustrator only.
